meta: A starter round of updates, fixes and care for your Squarespace site, handled in your own account. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Squarespace management, updates done for you
overview: This is a fixed starter sprint for busy Squarespace owners. We check your site, fix what is broken, then work through your list of updates: text and photos, product changes, blog posts, event listings, forms and newsletter blocks. You get a short report of what we did. Monthly care is quoted separately, and nothing renews without your written yes.

faq: No. This is a one-time starter sprint at a fixed price. If it suits you, we quote monthly care separately with a written scope, and nothing renews automatically.
Do I give you my login?
No. Invite us as a contributor from your Squarespace permissions and we work from there. We never ask for passwords, and you can remove our access whenever you like.
Can you answer my customers or manage orders?
This sprint is for site updates only. Order handling and customer messages are daily work that we quote separately if you want it.
Can you move my site to a different plan or domain?
We can guide you through plan and domain settings in your account and fix DNS records you control. Purchases and payments are made by you directly with Squarespace or your domain registrar.
